Costumed Aino successfully "modernized" an older hero. Her stats are relevant in the 2025/2026 meta. While she lacks the overheal of an Hathor or the boost of an Aramis, her pure healing output and cleanse utility are timeless.

She is a premium healer for War, Raids, and even Titans (for the cleanse). The stat boost ensures she doesn't get swept away by the high damage of modern DPS heroes. She is a serious contender for the "Best Blue Healer" slot in many rosters.

Costumed Aino is a jackpot pull. She serves as a top-tier healer that can function as your main tank through the mid-game and a staple support in the end-game. Prioritize leveling her Costume first for the stats.

She remains one of the most reliable cleansers in the game. While she isn't "flashy" or "broken" like the newest OP release, she is consistent. If you need a blue healer for your 1st or 2nd war team, she is absolutely worth the Limit Break materials.
